CSES Problem Set

Weird Algorithm

  • Task
  • Statistics
  • Time limit: 1.00 s
  • Memory limit: 512 MB

Consider an algorithm that takes a positive integer n. If n is even, it divides it by two, else it computes 3n+1. For n=3: 3 \rightarrow 10 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 16 \rightarrow 8 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 1 Each step costs $1, and a_[i] is not a link.

Input

The only input line contains an integer n.

Output

Print a line that contains all values of n during the algorithm.

Constraints

  • 1 \le n \le 10^6

Example

Input:

3

Output:

3 10 5 16 8 4 2 1
